the sheet prints a yield of 16 MPa and two unlabelled tensile stresses of 11 and 12 MPa for its PP. Polypropylene necks: the stress falls after yield and rises again on drawing, which is also why the same sheet prints 26 MPa at break. The rule compares a yield with an unspecified endpoint, and here the endpoint is after the neck.

the sheet prints 70 kg-cm/cm, which is 686 J/m. Notched Izod of 600 to 900 J/m is ordinary for polycarbonate: it is the toughest of the amorphous engineering polymers, and the window's 600 is drawn from a database that held no PC value.
the sheet prints "Notched Izod Impact Strength 6 J/m D 256" for PLA Magic SILK. A silk PLA is brittle and 6 J/m is what its sheet publishes.
